extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for users attempting to create a new Wikipedia article (handling missing-page notices, account requirements, searches, redirects, and deletion diagnostics).

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for 'Ramanujan Aiyangar' in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, use Wikipedia's search to ensure the topic isn't covered under a different title or spelling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check pages that link to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inspect incoming links (what links here) to discover related pages, redirects, or existing coverage that might make a new article unnecessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recent-creation visibility delay
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you expect a newly created page to appear, wait a few minutes or try the purge function to refresh caches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case sensitivity and redirect consideration
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalization variants and, if appropriate, create a redirect from the alternative form rather than a duplicate article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deleted-page diagnostic
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the deletion log to determine deletion reasons and follow guidance for addressing deletion causes before attempting recreation.
